company: OpenSearch Software Foundation (The Linux Foundation 프로젝트)
one_liner_ko: AI 기반 검색과 관측(observability)을 위한 Apache 2.0 오픈소스 검색·분석 엔진.
what_it_does_ko: OpenSearch는 데이터를 수집·검색·시각화·분석하는 커뮤니티 주도 오픈소스 검색·분석 제품군이다. 데이터 저장소이자 검색 엔진(OpenSearch), 시각화·UI(OpenSearch Dashboards), 서버 측 데이터 수집기(Data Prepper)로 구성되며 플러그인으로 검색·분석·관측·보안·머신러닝 기능을 넓힐 수 있다. Apache Lucene 위에 만들어졌고, 2021년 1월 Elasticsearch와 Kibana의 오픈소스 포크로 발표되었다. 2024년 9월 Linux Foundation 산하 OpenSearch Software Foundation이 만들어졌다.
key_features: Apache Lucene 기반 검색·분석 엔진(OpenSearch Core)

pricing.free_tier: 오픈소스(Apache 2.0) — 공식 페이지에 유료 요금제 없음

evidence.quote: The OpenSearch Software Foundation is the exciting next chapter for the OpenSearch Project, formed in September 2024.
The open engine for AI-powered search and observability
OpenSearch consists of a data store and search engine (OpenSearch), a visualization and user interface (OpenSearch Dashboards), and a server-side data collector (Data Prepper).
as an open-source fork of Elasticsearch and Kibana
OpenSearch is a powerful search and analytics engine built on Apache Lucene.
Power machine learning and generative AI applications with a high-performance database designed for the way AI understands data.
A server-side data collector designed to enrich, transform, and aggregate data for downstream analytics with Opensearch.
Clients Interact with OpenSearch from your application using language APIs.
Identify and resolve issues across your applications and infrastructure.
Detect and respond to security threats in real time.
OpenSearch is open source that stays open: vendor-neutral, fully Apache 2.0 licensed from ingest to dashboard
This project is licensed under the [Apache v2.0 License](LICENSE.txt).
